seo.title: Work with ODD — network, projects and partnerships
seo.description: Ways for organisations to take part in ODD — come to ODDference, stay involved through the network, bring us a project or build a partnership.

title: Work with ODD.
intro: Come because you want new perspectives. Because something in your organisation is stuck. Because you want to understand a cultural shift, meet people outside your usual field or build something with creative professionals. Start with ODDference, the network, a project or a partnership — whichever makes sense for what you are actually trying to do.

whyOdd.title: Access to creative expertise
whyOdd.body: ODD is built through real events, spaces and working relationships across creative and cultural fields. The value is not a contact list; it is the context and trust to bring the right people into the same conversation.

whyOdd.title: Cross-sector capability
whyOdd.body: ODD spends time across creative, business and public-sector contexts. That makes it easier to translate between different ways of thinking without flattening them into the same language.

whyOdd.title: Real communities & platforms
whyOdd.body: The work connects back to actual people and places: ODDfest across Helsinki, ODDference, and a year-round home at ODDspace.

pathways.title: ODDference
pathways.body: Come to ODDference, bring a team or build part of the event with us.

pathways.title: ODDmembership
pathways.body: ODDnetwork is being shaped as a year-round way for organisations that share the direction to stay involved, learn from each other and help build what comes next.

pathways.title: ODDagency
pathways.body: Bring us a question, brief or project. We shape the work with you and bring in the people it actually needs.

pathways.title: Partnerships
pathways.body: Build something with us across ODD's events, spaces or wider work — from funding what already exists to creating something new together.

pathways.title: Cities & Institutions
pathways.body: A programme or partnership shaped around your institution's own goals.

howWeWork.title: Start a conversation
howWeWork.body: Tell us what you are trying to do, change or understand.

howWeWork.title: Find the right pathway
howWeWork.body: We work out the simplest useful way to start — an event, the network, a project or a partnership.

howWeWork.title: Build together
howWeWork.body: Then we build the specifics together. The form follows the work, not the other way around.

network.title: Organisations building with ODD
network.note: A growing list of organisations already building with ODD — see the partners below, with more joining as the network grows.

contact.title: Tell us what you're working on.
contact.body: Tell us what you are working on, what is stuck, or what you would like to try. The form goes straight to the team.
